result.title: Reliable Recursive Memory for Causal Multi-scale Video Polyp Segmentation
result.comment: 13 pages, 9 figures, 9 tables. Extended version of CMSA-Net (MICCAI 2026). Submitted to Medical Image Analysis
result.summary: Video polyp segmentation (VPS) is essential for computer-aided colonoscopy, as it localizes and tracks polyps frame by frame. However, VPS remains challenging because polyps resemble the mucosa and change quickly in scale, which calls for history beyond a short clip, and because blur, specular highlights, and occlusion often degrade only part of a frame. Existing methods keep history as whole frames, so their cost grows with the history length, and a partly degraded frame carries its degraded content to later predictions. To address these issues, we propose STREAM, a streaming framework for VPS that extends the causal multi-scale aggregation (CMA) of our conference work from a fixed clip to an online stream. STREAM introduces a Recursive Slot Memory (RSM) that summarizes multi-scale features and soft foreground and background cues into a constant number of slots, which the current features read and pass to CMA, supplying long-range history at a constant cost. Furthermore, we design Reliability-Aware Slot Writing (RASW), which estimates a pixel-level quality map from the current frame, supervised by its local error, and uses it to control which locations are written into RSM and how much each slot is updated. Experiments on SUN-SEG and CVC-ClinicDB demonstrate that STREAM achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving the Dice of the conference model from 81.3% to 85.7% on the hardest subset while running at 48 FPS with a constant state of 0.32 MB. Code will be released at https://github.com/wangtong627/STREAM.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 STREAM 流式视频息肉分割框架：用固定数量的递归 slot memory 将多尺度特征与软前景/背景线索压缩为常量状态供后续帧读取，并用由局部误差监督的像素级质量图控制槽位写入，在常量内存下保留长程历史。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「以误差监督质量图、按可靠性门控写入固定槽位」的机制可供核查是否能用于 LVR 中长期视觉证据的压缩缓存与低质量（模糊、遮挡）证据的过滤，但原论文属医学视频分割，与 VLM 推理无直接关系。
